authority.document: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

scope: Independent physical HEADER envelope and locator audit for the existing locally generated populated-links AC1012 witness pair.
checks: Both packet drawings are hash-matched to their handoff manifest. Each has three non-overlapping bounded locators, a valid file-header CRC and sentinel, a 508-byte HEADER section at offset 70, a 470-byte payload, valid section CRC fd02, matching section sentinels and no unclaimed section bytes.
Both files reject eight separate damaged controls, including repaired-CRC duplicate and out-of-range locators; every truncated prefix is refused and the original input succeeds on retry.
The existing 32-frame per-drawing object census calls the shared HEADER observer; both drawings pass the combined census and the focused legacy BLOCK_HEADER adapter probe.
Source-release inventory check and self-test pass. No DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
limits: These envelope and CRC checks do not decode or qualify individual HEADER variable spans or semantics, entire graph closure, whole-file output, native normal-open, or cloning behavior.
Both inputs are specification-directed, LibreDWG-generated controls; matching independent structural checks do not establish native AutoCAD semantics.
